component: Account Hub address-book sync navigation and completion

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The sync step now awaits provider create returns in order, keeps the first truthy directory result and passes its optional UID through a helper that emits request-close then awaits toAddressBook. The local-book path shares that helper. This does not wait every provider initial remote fetch: CardDAV create returns before its scheduled fetch. Tests separately wait tab/ready/close/sync signals and check selected book plus search focus; current selection wait is later. Empty/falsy returns and rejected creation are not fully covered. No account, focus, sync or test ran.
title: Account Hub opens the first returned address-book directory after ordered creation calls
